# The v12 motion contract

v12 components take their motion from `@carbon-labs/v12-motion` only. It
re-exports carbon-motion's published packages, `@carbon-labs/motion-core` and
`@carbon-labs/motion-react` (0.1.1), item by item, so the seam's exports are the
whole of the motion a v12 component may use.

## What a motion item allows

| Motion item         | Allowed in a component at                         |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `exploring`, public | carbon-labs `draft`                               |
| `approved`, public  | carbon-labs `preview`                             |
| `promoted`          | anywhere; the seam reads it from `@carbon/motion` |

Every module carbon-motion publishes is `exploring` today, so every v12
component stays at `labs.status: draft`. Each token carries its own status:

- `promoted` (5): `duration-slow-01`, `surface-contextual`,
  `surface-disclosure`, `surface-expand`, `surface-invoke`
- `approved` (14): `duration-fast-00`, `duration-fast-01`, `duration-fast-02`,
  `duration-moderate-01`, `duration-moderate-02`, `duration-moderate-03`,
  `duration-slow-02`, `duration-slow-03`, `easing-entrance-expressive`,
  `easing-entrance-productive`, `easing-exit-expressive`,
  `easing-exit-productive`, `easing-standard-expressive`,
  `easing-standard-productive`
- `exploring` (76): `chartReveal-dissolve`, `chartReveal-front`,
  `chartReveal-move`, `chartReveal-phaseGap`, `chartReveal-projectedFront`,
  `chartReveal-rule`, `depth-arrive`, `depth-recede-dim`, `depth-recede-scale`,
  `distance-lg`, `distance-md`, `distance-nudge`, `distance-sm`, `distance-xl`,
  `distance-xs`, `duration-frame`, `duration-instant`, `origin-center`,
  `origin-pointer`, `origin-top`, `origin-trigger`, `pattern-axial-default`,
  `pattern-axial-floating`, `pattern-elevation-floating`,
  `pattern-elevation-raised`, `pattern-elevation-resting`, `pattern-loading`,
  `pattern-pointer-origin`, `pattern-reduced-motion`,
  `pattern-relayout-distance-steps`, `pattern-relayout-reflow`,
  `pattern-rollover-lightness`, `pattern-rollover-rehover`,
  `pattern-rollover-shape`, `pattern-selection-arrival`,
  `pattern-selection-lead-curve`, `pattern-selection-list-timing`,
  `pattern-selection-reach`, `pattern-selection-reach-duration`,
  `pattern-selection-stretch`, `pattern-selection-timing`,
  `pattern-skeleton-contrast`, `pattern-skeleton-wave`, `pattern-snap-floating`,
  `pattern-snap-mark`, `pattern-snap-notification`, `pattern-snap-surface`,
  `pattern-snap-tooltip`, `pattern-stagger-size-steps`,
  `pattern-stagger-window`, `pattern-stillness-window`, `reduce-duration-floor`,
  `role-dismiss`, `role-emphasis`, `role-enter`, `role-exit`, `role-move`,
  `scale-emphasis`, `scale-enter`, `scale-press`, `scale-subtle`, `soft-edge`,
  `spring-bouncy`, `spring-gentle`, `spring-settle`, `spring-snap`,
  `stagger-step-01`, `stagger-step-02`, `stagger-step-03`, `stagger-step-04`,
  `stagger-step-05`, `stagger-step-06`, `stagger-step-07`, `stagger-step-08`,
  `stagger-step-09`, `stagger-step-10`

## Reduced motion

Each component declares its reduced-motion behavior in its stories (a shorter
clock, or at once), and the workbench's Motion panel shows it. The page's level
comes from `data-motion-level` (`full`, `reduced`, `none`), which the seam's
`tokens.css` reads.
